original: 圣人**常善救人**，故**无弃人**。
vernacular_zh: 圣人总是善于挽救人，所以没有被遗弃的人。
translation_en: In the same way the sage is always skilful at saving men, and so he does not cast away any man.

scripture.text_zh: 人子来，为要寻找、拯救失丧的人。他愿意万人得救，明白真道。
scripture.text_en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost. ... Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
scripture.ref_zh: 路加福音 19:10; 提摩太前书 2:4

insight_zh: 老子：圣人善救，**故无弃人**；路加：人子亲来，**寻找失丧**。
insight_en: Laozi: the sage saves, **casting no one away**. Luke: the Son of man came **to seek the lost**.
